newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse to invest $120 mln in Grupo MVS.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse to invest $120 mln in Grupo MVS.

text.p: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc, a private investment firm, said Monday it will invest $120 million for a minority equity stake in Mexico's Grupo MVS SA de CV, one of Latin America's leading telecommunications companies.

All of the proceeds from the investment will be used by MVS to repay the company's debt and for capital expenditures to support expected growth, particularly in multichannel multipoint distribution systems and direct-to-home satellite television broadcasting.
MVS is principally owned by the Vargas family of Mexico City.

The company has four lines of business: MVS Multivision, a pay-TV operation; Galaxy Latin America, one of two direct-to-home satellite broadcasting companies that cover all of Latin America; Telerey, one of the leading Latin American programming, production, post- production, playback and uplink services businesses; and Grupo Teleradio, a major radio broadcasting company.

Thomas Hicks, chairman and chief executive officer of Hicks, Muse, said the investment "is both an indication of our enthusiasm for MVS and the Vargas family, and of our confidence in the future of the Mexican economy."
